question: Who has been elected as the chairman of the Audit Bureau of Circulations (ABC) for the year 2020-21?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra V Darda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Devendra V Darda was elected as the chairman of the Audit Bureau of Circulations (ABC) for the year **2020-2021**.
 
• **Position**: Managing Director of Lokmat Media Group.
 
• **Industry Experience**: Darda has served on several media industry bodies, including **INS** (Indian Newspaper Society) and **IFRA** (International Newspaper Association).
 
• **Education Contributions**: He is the president of various educational institutions in **Yavatmal, Maharashtra**.
 
• **Sports Involvement**: He is also on the managing committee of the **Western India Football Association**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Purpose**: The ABC is a non-profit organization that audits and certifies the circulation of newspapers and magazines to ensure transparency and accuracy in reported circulation figures.
 
• **Functions**:
 
 
• **Circulation Audits**: Conducts yearly audits of newspapers and periodicals to verify their circulation figures.
 
• **Certification**: Issues certificates for audited publications, allowing them to be listed on the Central Media List, which grants access to public sector advertisement rates.
 
• **Industry Standards**: Provides industry-agreed standards for measuring media brands to promote consistency and credibility.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Foundation**: It was established in **1948** by representatives from the advertising and publishing industries to provide a reliable means for verifying circulation numbers.
